exposure: Gestational age at delivery (<34 weeks, 34-36 weeks, >36 weeks)
outcome: Preterm birth in the second pregnancy
cohort: 1,076,517 women in the United States delivering a singleton infant in their second live birth in 2016
finding: Women who had a cesarean delivery in their first pregnancy were 14% more likely to have a preterm birth in their second pregnancy compared to women who had not previously experienced a cesarean delivery.
